title: Build-output measurements
responsibility: Formats native/Wasm build sizes, reviewed limits and comparisons separately by target.

inputs.name: emittedChange.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier whose declarations and measurements are compared. Only its process and Wasm targets can produce rows.

inputs.name: emittedChange.sides
inputs.type: Array<{ units: HarnessUnit[]; record: HarnessRecord | null }>
inputs.description: Each side pairs unit definitions with a record, and unit definitions across all supplied sides determine the process and Wasm targets. Only the first two records provide before and after values; a missing match is null.

units.title: Build-output measurements
units.responsibility: Formats native/Wasm build sizes, reviewed limits and comparisons separately by target.

inputs.name: emittedTargets.index
inputs.description: History index searched for the requested unit's growth points. A missing unit or history without recognized process or Wasm keys yields an empty result.

inputs.name: emittedTargets.unit
inputs.description: Identifier of the unit whose growth history is inspected. Only process and Wasm targets are returned, in that fixed order.

inputs.name: emittedBytes.count
inputs.description: Number interpolated into the byte label without conversion or validation. Exactly 1 uses the singular label; every other value uses the plural label.

inputs.name: emittedLabel.target
inputs.description: Target name to label for display. Process and Wasm have fixed labels; any other name is returned unchanged.

inputs.name: emittedKey.target
inputs.description: Target name appended to the artifact-bytes metric prefix. The function does not validate the target name.

inputs.name: built.record
inputs.description: Record whose measurements are searched for this unit and the artifact-bytes metric. A match must have the requested target and falsy workload and profile; null or no match returns undefined.

inputs.name: built.unit
inputs.description: Identifier that must exactly match the measurement's unit field. It is used together with the metric, target, workload, and profile filters.

inputs.name: built.target
inputs.description: Optional target name matched exactly against a measurement's target field; omission matches an undefined target. Defaults to undefined.

inputs.name: targetsOf.unit
inputs.description: Unit whose runtime target declarations are inspected. Only process and Wasm kinds are retained, in the fixed process-then-Wasm order.

examples.title: Build-output measurements
examples.responsibility: Formats native/Wasm build sizes, reviewed limits and comparisons separately by target.

inputs.name: harnessEmitted.unit
inputs.description: Unit whose runtime declarations and emitted limits determine the output lines. Units without process or Wasm targets receive a single no-output line.

examples.title: Build-output measurements
examples.responsibility: Formats native/Wasm build sizes, reviewed limits and comparisons separately by target.

inputs.name: harnessEmitted.record
inputs.description: Record used for build measurements and budget findings, or null when no record is available. Only workload-free, profile-free artifact-bytes measurements are used for sizes.

outputs.name: emittedBytes
outputs.description: Formats the count as a decimal string followed by byte only when the count equals 1; all other counts use bytes.

outputs.name: emittedLabel
outputs.description: Maps process to process (native) and wasm to Wasm. Unknown target names pass through unchanged.

outputs.name: emittedKey
outputs.description: Prefixes the target name with artifact-bytes: for use as the ledger or growth-note key.

outputs.name: harnessEmitted
outputs.description: Returns one line per declared process or Wasm target, with its measured value, limit, and optional budget finding. With no such target it returns one none line; a missing size is described and never treated as zero.

examples.value: none: This unit declares no process or Wasm output.

examples.label: process (native)
examples.note: Grew from 1024 to 2560 bytes without a recorded approval.

outputs.name: emittedChange
outputs.description: Returns one row for each process or Wasm target declared on either side, in fixed order. Before and after are measured byte counts or null when the corresponding size is absent.

outputs.name: emittedTargets
outputs.description: Returns process and Wasm keys found in the unit's growth emitted maps or artifact-bytes notes, in fixed order. Missing units and histories without those keys produce an empty array.
